# PPT Master Skill

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor: Generates editable native PowerPoint decks from documents or a topic, with reusable brand templates, layout, animation and optional narration, for polished decks ready to present. It routes each request to one workflow, from generation to template creation and native editing.

The skill ships 478 scripts and 27 workflows behind six routes: generate, beautify, image to PPTX, create template, edit native PPTX and a quick mode, with blocking gates that wait for explicit confirmation. At every invocation it runs scripts/attribution_guard.py, an integrity gate that stops the skill on any non-zero result; the guard makes no network call and reads no secret. Sponsor model and API recommendations stay out of the way and are read only when explicitly asked for. By @hugohe3, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Narration audio may need a paid TTS or API.
